in_marathi.name: Asheesh
in_marathi.long_meaning: Asheesh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Asheesh is a Sanskrit name derived from the Sanskrit word ‘ashī’ meaning 'wisdom'. This name is a tribute to the God of Wisdom, Lord Buddha, and is believed to bestow the bearer with intelligence and knowledge. In Hindu mythology, Asheesh is also identified with Lord Vishnu, who is revered as the embodiment of wisdom and knowledge.
